messages:
ops-bot: :warning: Alert: Multiple runtime pods entering CrashLoopBackOff in cluster inference-us (service=runtime). >40% of runtime-gpu replica set impacted. Paging @oncall-eng.

sam: grabbing this. seeing crash loops across nodes gpu-a1, gpu-a2, gpu-a3. Pod restarts show SIGSEGV in runtime-engine worker process.

lee: I pulled recent pod logs — pattern repeats: `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'` then `Segmentation fault (core dumped)` followed by `cudaErrorIllegalAddress`.

sam: confirm: restart delay ~20s; restartCount across pods between 6-20. Starting emergency mitigation.

tori: any recent deploy? I see image `redwood/runtime:3.8.0` rolled 8m ago with new TRT fused kernels enabled by default.

ops-bot: action recorded: deploy 3.8.0 completed at 1792345560.

sam: rolling back to last known-good `redwood/runtime:3.7.4` on a small canary (2 pods) to test.

lee: while that runs, quick routing tweak — divert traffic for high-memory models to cpu-fallback cluster and bump retries at gateway. Doing now.

cs-bot: note: CS reported 4 customers seeing generation failures; top-50 endpoints have error rate spiking to 18%. Marking customer-impact: high.

ops-bot: event: oncall-eng paged at 1792345582.

oncall-eng: ack. taking incident. Sam handing off.

oncall-eng: running `kubectl describe pod runtime-gpu-2 -n inference-us` shows event loop: Back-off restarting failed container. Core dumps present in /var/crash.

lee: can we flip an env flag to bypass TRT path? There's `ENABLE_TRT_FUSED=0` feature gate.

sam: yes, runtime honors `ENABLE_TRT_FUSED`. Patching deployment now to set it for canary.

ops-bot: action log: patched deployment env ENABLE_TRT_FUSED=0 at 1792345610.

sam: canary pods (3.7.4 + ENABLE_TRT_FUSED=0) healthy after 2 mins. No segfaults seen so far.

lee: GPU metrics: memory usage steady, no OOM spikes. This looks like illegal memory access triggered by fused kernel launch path.

ops-bot: created channel #incident-inf-4800 at 1792345640 for focused comms and invited relevant owners.

cs-bot: notifying account teams and affected customers with an initial status: "We are mitigating a runtime regression impacting some GPU-backed endpoints. We have rolled back the runtime for canaries and are routing traffic to fallback pools."

sam: plan: 1) prevent new pods from scheduling on affected hardware (cordon gpu-a2) 2) complete rollback to 3.7.4 across cluster 3) set ENABLE_TRT_FUSED=0 globally 4) capture cores and run gdb on one dump.

oncall-eng: cordoned gpu-a2 at 1792345670. evicting pods gracefully.

lee: initiating cluster-wide rollout to 3.7.4 with env change: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:3.7.4 -n inference-us` and `kubectl patch deploy/runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"ENABLE_TRT_FUSED","value":"0"}]}]}}}}'`.

ops-bot: rollout started at 1792345695.

sam: debugging cores: `gdb --batch --ex 'thread apply all bt full' --core core.123 runtime-engine` shows crash in trt_fused::launch_kernel + invalid device pointer deref. Suspect pointer arithmetic bug when tensors are non-contiguous or when KV cache small.

lee: code team note: a change to stride computation landed in PR #4125, suspected to corrupt kernel params for certain layouts. Repro in staging with Ampere A100 and CUDA 12.1.

oncall-eng: increasing readiness probes timeout so we don't kill pods too quickly during analysis. `kubectl patch` applied.

cs-bot: update: customer-visible errors dropping to ~3% after partial rollback and routing changes.

ops-bot: action: created JIRA INF-4800 for post-incident follow-up and customer comms at 1792345740.

sam: continuing rollout; monitoring health. If full rollback wins, we'll hold and prepare a hotfix branch.

lee: also recommending adding a deploy canary job that runs a tiny fused-kernel sanity kernel on each new runtime build on a sample Ampere node before full rollout.

oncall-eng: timeline snippet for ticket:
- 1792345678: alert fired
- 1792345695: ENABLE_TRT_FUSED=0 set for canary
- 1792345670: cordoned gpu-a2
- 1792345740: INF-4800 created
- 1792345890: rollback continuing cluster-wide

sam: full rollback finished; pod restarts falling to 0-1, crashloops cleared. 5xx rate down to 0.9%.

lee: recommend keeping ENABLE_TRT_FUSED disabled until code fix merged and validated. Running extended soak for 2 hours.

oncall-eng: customer comms draft ready: "We identified a regression in a fused TensorRT path causing segmentation faults on some GPU hardware. We rolled back the runtime to the prior stable version and disabled the fused kernels; traffic has recovered. We will deliver a tested hotfix and roll it out with canaries and expanded GPU CI."

ops-bot: incident INF-4800 state: mitigation-in-progress, customers-notified, severity=P1 at 1792345910.

tori: follow-ups: (sam) coordinate node uncordon & soak, (lee) add kernel canary CI, (dev) patch PR to fix stride arithmetic, (product) prepare customer status update.

oncall-eng: handing incident to follow-up owners for postmortem. I'll remain on-call for 1hr. Good work everyone.

ops-bot: thread snapshot archived to /incidents/1792345678/logs at 1792345910."
